activity_gate_bracket.scope: Candidate linked-wet-peak gate, expressed in the earlier envelope normalization. Control tails are negligible in these isolated, unclipped reset probes.

method: Fit one symmetric clipping threshold in the untouched right channel before its first repeat. Known fixed latency/filter/gain; no wet alignment search. Input LP truncated at 128 samples. Stereo-reset subtracts the earlier unclipped right control using its fixed linear response.
limitations: First-pass threshold identification only; no full-render or hardware certificate.
Tone/DC normalization is a model convention; pulse normalization uses the earlier first-block fit.
Activity-reset criterion and exact arithmetic require independent complete-render checks.

rejected_hypothesis.conclusion: The exact binary gate is rejected; use the measured bracket as an empirical candidate, not a manufacturer constant.
